dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: One of your rich friends, I'd assume. After all, you gotta be pretty well-off to live in the city, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That still doesn't really narrow it down... We know lots of people with lots of Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Wow... I guess being a national hero earns you friends in high places...
